design.status_of_evidence: Lee2019 participants as in C3 (independent of HS-Stroke); a different estimand on 2-s windows; C3 and C4 share participants and pairs and are not independent of each other
design.features: window-local 2-s covariances (8-30 Hz causal Butterworth from each window's own first sample, OAS) at V0.0 [0,2), V0.5, V1.0, V1.5, V2.0 [2,4) s after the cue and P [-2.5,-0.5) s (fixation)
design.pairs_split: identical to C3 (lee2019.build_tasks: leave-one-run-out, 8,640 same-run same-class pairs)
design.arms: per pair and variant v: C + v(a) vs C + v(b), exact-optimum per-arm TS+LR refit; base and scored rows = V0.0
design.aggregation: G3 rule; 54 participants; t95 CI; Monte Carlo sign-flip (1e6, seed 7499); Holm over S1-S4
design.interpretation_rule: d(V2.0) > 0 means an advantage from the same MI episode without any shared sample; d(V0.0) - d(V2.0) > 0 means an additional advantage that requires shared samples

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_primary: d(V0.0), the 2-s-window PMIS identity swap, differs from 0 (expected > 0); MC sign-flip over 54 participants
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2_mechanism: the copy advantage decreases monotonically with sample overlap 100 > 75 > 50 > 25 > 0 % (reported as met / not met from participant means)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.key_quantity: d(V2.0) / d(V0.0): the fraction of the exact-copy advantage that survives with NO shared samples (same MI episode, adjacent 2 s); d(P): same trial, pre-cue fixation (same moment, no MI content)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
